exclusion_reason: The compute/UAV-SSBO prototype is implemented: it models an element-wise compute dispatch over a storage buffer, computes the software reference output, describes the dispatch and its storage bindings, and names any above-limit content (workgroup size beyond the invocation limit, or an op outside the compute subset) rather than dropping it. This is prototype-only ([P4]); compute is WebGPU/compatibility-only. The benchmark remains red because bit-identity on the declared live adapter set is not measured in the gate.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the compute fixture is bit-identical on the declared adapter set and above-limit content is named-blocked.
expected_failing_assertion: The compute fixture is measured bit-identical on the declared live adapter set.
active_gate_evidence: The shader suite proves the compute prototype computes the reference output over a storage buffer and names above-limit workgroup size and out-of-subset ops rather than dropping them.
procedure: Run the compute research fixture on the declared adapter set.
pass_criterion: Compute output is bit-identical on the declared set.
